starter_files.purpose: Setup, behaviors, environment requirements, and verification steps.

stretch_features: Add a focused automated regression test for each critical workflow.
Measure a real performance or accessibility issue and document the baseline and follow-up.
Explain architectural trade-offs and what belongs in a trusted backend.
tests_and_validation: Test keyboard-only navigation and an accessible name for every control.
Test empty data, invalid input, and remote request failure.
Build the production bundle and test a direct URL refresh.

rubric.criterion: Edge cases, errors, and security boundaries

review_method: Human review against the milestone acceptance criteria and rubric. No automatic certificate is implied.
